questions.question: What is the second truth called in this passage?
questions.answer: It is called absolute dominicality.

questions.question: What signs in the universe point to this truth?
questions.answer: The passage points to the wise and caring management seen all through the universe, especially in living things and how they are raised and developed.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way this care happens everywhere?
questions.answer: It says it happens in the same general way everywhere, yet in surprising forms.

questions.question: Why can this absolute dominicality not have any partner?
questions.answer: Because its important goals would be harmed if even the smallest thing were linked to a partner beside Allah.

questions.question: What are some of those goals of dominicality named in the passage?
questions.answer: They include showing beauty, announcing perfection, displaying precious works, and making hidden excellences known.

questions.question: Why does the passage pay special attention to small living things and particular cases?
questions.answer: Because those great purposes are gathered and shown clearly even in tiny and specific creatures.

questions.question: What would happen if people turned toward causes instead of the One who planned everything?
questions.answer: They would be turned away from the true source and purposes, and that would go against dominicality.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does such a wrong turning relate to the nature of dominicality?
questions.answer: It is described as opposing and fighting against its very nature.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an does because of this truth?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an again and again points people to Allah’s oneness and declares His freedom from any partner.

questions.question: How strongly does the passage describe the Qur’an’s guidance to unity?
questions.answer: It describes that guidance as constant and very widespread, reaching even to its verses, words, letters, and their forms.

questions.question: Which part of the universe is especially mentioned as showing caring rule?
questions.answer: Living things are especially mentioned.

questions.question: What two qualities describe the hidden hand working through the universe?
questions.answer: It is described as wise and compassionate.

questions.question: What two activities in living things are named as examples of this rule?
questions.answer: Their nurturing and their development are named.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from these signs?
questions.answer: It concludes that they are a clear proof of absolute dominicality.

questions.question: What word in the passage shows there is no doubt about this proof?
questions.answer: It says this is so without doubt.

questions.question: Why would adding a partner to Allah be a serious problem even in one tiny creature?
questions.answer: Because even there it would spoil the goals that dominicality wants to bring about.

questions.question: What are people called in the passage when it speaks about their attention and understanding?
questions.answer: They are called conscious beings.

questions.question: Why is turning conscious beings toward causes wrong according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because it pulls them away from the true planner and from the real purpose behind creation.

questions.question: What attitude of the Qur’an toward Allah is mentioned near the end?
questions.answer: The Qur’an often declares Allah’s perfect purity and greatness above any partner.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an’s verses and even smaller parts of it?
questions.answer: It says not only the verses and words but even the letters and their shapes guide people to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What truth is being explained in this passage?
questions.answer: The passage explains absolute dominicality.

questions.question: What everyday observation helps prove this truth?
questions.answer: We can see that living things are cared for, grown, and managed in wise and merciful ways.

questions.question: Does the passage present this care as random or purposeful?
questions.answer: It presents it as purposeful.

questions.question: Which words in the passage support the idea of purpose?
questions.answer: The passage supports it by describing the working as wise, compassionate, and aimed at important goals.

questions.question: What important goals of dominicality are listed?
questions.answer: They are showing beauty, making perfection known, revealing fine works, and displaying hidden excellences.

questions.question: Why are details and small creatures important in this argument?
questions.answer: Because the passage says those great meanings are focused into particular things and animate beings.

questions.question: What would be the result if a partner were assigned to Allah in these matters?
questions.answer: The purposes would fail and the aims would be ruined.

questions.question: What mistake can conscious beings make according to the passage?
questions.answer: They can turn their attention to causes instead of the One who designed and willed everything.

questions.question: Why is that mistake so serious in the passage’s view?
questions.answer: Because it goes directly against the very meaning of Allah’s lordship and care.

questions.question: How does the passage connect this idea to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an repeatedly teaches Allah’s transcendence and oneness because of this very truth.

questions.question: According to the passage, where can a person see signs of Lordly care?
questions.answer: A person can see them throughout the whole universe.

questions.question: What makes these signs especially clear in living things?
questions.answer: Their growth, care, and development show ordered mercy and wisdom very clearly.

questions.question: Why is the working called both widespread and surprising?
questions.answer: Because it appears everywhere in a similar way, but each case also has unexpected and special features.

questions.question: What does the word absolute suggest about dominicality here?
questions.answer: It suggests that this rule is complete, unlimited, and not shared.

questions.question: What would happen to the goals of dominicality if a partner were accepted?
questions.answer: Those goals would be blocked and damaged.

questions.question: Name one goal of dominicality mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: One goal is to make divine beauty known.

questions.question: What is another goal mentioned there?
questions.answer: Another goal is to show perfect works and excellences.

questions.question: Why is directing people only to causes not enough?
questions.answer: Because causes are not the true owner and planner behind the blessings and order.

questions.question: How does the passage describe such direction toward causes?
questions.answer: It describes it as being against and unfriendly to the very essence of dominicality.

questions.question: What role does the Qur’an play in relation to this truth?
questions.answer: The Qur’an serves as a steady guide that teaches Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What kind of care in the universe is mentioned first in the passage?
questions.answer: It first mentions a wise and merciful care working everywhere.

questions.question: Is this care limited to one place or spread everywhere?
questions.answer: It is spread everywhere.

questions.question: Which creatures are highlighted most in showing this care?
questions.answer: Animate beings, or living creatures, are highlighted most.

questions.question: What does their nurturing and growth act as?
questions.answer: It acts as a strong proof of absolute dominicality.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there can be no partner in this dominicality?
questions.answer: Because a partner would interfere with the purposes and beauty meant to appear in creation.

questions.question: What are some beautiful results dominicality wants to show?
questions.answer: It wants to show beauty, perfection, artistic works, and hidden excellences.

questions.question: How can even a tiny mistake in belief harm these meanings, according to the passage?
questions.answer: If even the smallest thing is connected to a partner, those meanings are spoiled.

questions.question: What happens when people look only at causes?
questions.answer: They are pulled away from the true Creator and the real purpose behind things.

questions.question: Why is this more than a small error in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it clashes with the whole meaning of Allah’s caring rule.

questions.question: What parts of the Qur’an are said to guide people to unity?
questions.answer: Its verses, its words, and even its letters and their shapes.

questions.question: What is the title of the truth discussed in this passage?
questions.answer: The title is absolute dominicality.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give of how Allah deals with creation?
questions.answer: It gives a picture of all creation being managed with wisdom, mercy, and careful development.

questions.question: What words show that this management is seen all across creation?
questions.answer: The passage says it is found throughout the cosmos and everywhere.

questions.question: What does the passage say about sharing this lordship with another?
questions.answer: It says such sharing cannot be accepted at all.

questions.question: Why are particular creatures important in showing great truths?
questions.answer: Because major purposes are gathered and displayed in individual creatures and living beings.

questions.question: What purpose of dominicality is connected to showing wonderful works?
questions.answer: One purpose is making precious and fine works visible.

questions.question: What wrong direction might conscious beings take?
questions.answer: They might give too much credit to causes and forget the One who planned everything.

questions.question: Why would that be hostile to dominicality?
questions.answer: Because it would hide the true Lord and block the purpose of creation from being understood rightly.

questions.question: How often does the passage suggest the Qur’an teaches this lesson?
questions.answer: It suggests the Qur’an teaches it abundantly and repeatedly.

questions.question: What belief do the Qur’an’s many signs keep pointing people toward?
questions.answer: They keep pointing people toward Allah’s unity.
